concerns.text: FR-012 specifies an a priori power analysis using a two‑sample t‑test framework (e.g., statsmodels.stats.power.TTestIndPower) to detect a standardized effect size β = 0.1 for the primary association tests, which are Spearman correlations on CLR‑transformed data and MaAsLin2 linear models. A t‑test power calculation is not appropriate for these statistical models, making the power analysis method mismatched to the hypothesis tests and potentially leading to incorrect sample‑size requirements.
